selected_skill.purpose: Guide the agent toward a changelog-delivery workflow that classifies the release channel, updates the correct pages, and keeps the local generation entrypoint reusable.

selection_rationale: High-star fit for changelog generation with explicit guidance for stable and preview release flows.
Public repository inputs only. No external account, login state, publish permission, or user data access is required.
Supports a single-container task where with_skill and without_skill can differ only by environment/skills.

rejected_high_star_skills.reason: The workflow leans on GitHub milestone and review actions that are less suitable for a local single-container template.
The scope centers on cross-provider release coordination rather than one bundled changelog delivery path.
Requires an external design source and does not match the changelog automation target.

task_shape.runtime: single-container Python and Node workspace with bundled changelog pages, release payload, local contracts, and bundled skill references
task_shape.solver_action: complete the changelog deliverables through the formal entrypoint instead of returning a prose report

planned_verifier_focus: Formal build entrypoint produces all required markdown outputs and the manifest
Release channel and release kind are inferred correctly from the bundled version string
Stable minor updates reach latest.md and index.md, while preview minor updates reach preview.md
Highlights, announcement PRs, and changelog link are grounded in the bundled release material
Alternate fixture reruns prove the workflow is not hardcoded to one visible release payload

real_data_sources.reference: Gemini CLI changelog index from tag v0.40.0
Gemini CLI stable changelog page from tag v0.40.0
Gemini CLI preview changelog page from tag v0.40.0
GitHub release page for Gemini CLI v0.40.0

with_without_difference_policy: Only environment/skills/ and the corresponding runtime skill-copy logic may differ between with_skill and without_skill variants.

local_validation.starter_workspace_expected_result: Fails substantive verifier checks because the starter generator does not complete both channel-aware update paths and does not emit a full manifest.

iteration_notes: Do not rely on editing the selected skill contents to complete the task.
Do not alter instruction.md, tests, data, dependencies, or contracts between with_skill and without_skill variants.
Favor action-level failures such as updating the wrong changelog page, omitting announcement data, or hardcoding one channel path over cosmetic markdown differences.
Finalize README metrics only after completed E2B comparison runs.
